Geographies Served Programs Support to Children State Maharashtra States Maharashtra EnsureS that destitute children go to nearby schools and provide them with all they need for their education, including books, uniforms, bags, and fees. The children stay in the ashram and attend school. All their daily needs are met by the ashram. The organization supports 90 such children who are studying from standard 1 to college-going students. At Panvel - Shelter and Food State Maharashtra States Maharashtra Currently accommodating 100 inmates, Janakalyan Sevashram is a three-story facility with 30 independent rooms, a shared kitchen and dining area, and a common dining hall. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are supplied for each prisoner, along with complete medical treatment. The Ashram pays all of the children's tuition at the local colleges and schools where they go. The children also receive special tuition. In addition, they receive school supplies like textbooks, backpacks, and uniforms. The donations that the Ashram receives from generous philanthropists and well-wishers cover all of its costs.
